# Cue catalog — production list

`cues.combat` declares **204 cues**. Each row is a deliverable with its technical specification;
the catalog JSON is validated in CI (grammar, variation minimums, particle budgets, photosensitivity caps, asset prefixes)
and every move must pass the presentation Definition of Done (`CueCoverage`). Editing guide:
[03-Animation/00-AnimationStandards.md](03-Animation/00-AnimationStandards.md), [04-VFX/00-VfxStandards.md](04-VFX/00-VfxStandards.md),
[06-Audio/README.md](06-Audio/README.md).

| Channel | Cues | Files to produce |
|---|---:|---|
| sfx | 52 | 702 audio files |
| vfx | 66 | 66 prefabs (+ optional mobile-low variants) |
| cam | 22 | 2 Timeline sequences; the rest are parameters |
| vo | 21 | 2322 audio files |
| foley | 10 | 68 audio files |
| haptic | 6 | parameters only |
| impact | 27 | parameters only |

`{Weapon}` assets are produced once per weapon class (13); `{Character}` assets once per voiced combatant (8 principal
characters + 24 bosses). Blood layers (`gore`) are skipped when the player disables blood.

## VFX

and PC only; realtime lights on PC only.

## Camera

Amplitude units: shake metres, push fraction of camera distance, tilt and zoom degrees, flash peak opacity. All camera
motion is scaled by the player's camera-motion setting; flashes can be disabled (photosensitivity).

| Cue | Kind | Amplitude | Frequency Hz | Frames | Extra | Intent | Fired by |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| `cam.shake.light` | Shake | 0.02 | 24 | 8 | — | Light positional shake for light contact. | impact.block.heavy, impact.clash, impact.hit.light, impact.knockdown.hard, katana.hcharged |
| `cam.shake.medium` | Shake | 0.045 | 20 | 12 | — | Medium shake for heavy contact and throws. | impact.groundbounce, impact.hit.counter, impact.hit.heavy, universal.throwback.hit, universal.throwforward.hit |
| `cam.shake.heavy` | Shake | 0.08 | 18 | 16 | — | Heavy shake for slams, bounces and guard breaks. | impact.guardbreak, impact.knockout, impact.wallbounce, katana.h3, katana.sreprisal |
| `cam.shake.ultra` | Shake | 0.14 | 14 | 26 | — | Ultra shake reserved for full-charge, ultimate and finisher blows. | impact.finisher, katana.hchargedfull, katana.ultimate.hit |
| `cam.push.heavy` | Push | 0.03 | — | 18 | — | Subtle dolly-in during heavy wind-ups to sell commitment; releases on recovery. | katana.bh, katana.dh, katana.h1, katana.h2, katana.h3, katana.jh +2 more |
| `cam.push.charge` | Push | 0.06 | — | 60 | — | Slow dolly-in while charging; resets on release or cancel. | katana.hcharge |
| `cam.push.throw` | Push | 0.05 | — | 30 | — | Throw framing: dolly toward the pair for the slam. | universal.throwback.hit, universal.throwforward.hit |
| `cam.push.stance` | Push | 0.04 | — | 24 | — | Counter stance: slight push to build tension. | katana.s |
| `cam.push.rush` | Push | 0.04 | — | 16 | — | Rush: short push that leads the fighter's travel direction. | katana.qcfs |
| `cam.push.special` | Push | 0.035 | — | 20 | — | Generic special-move push. | katana.qcbs |
| `cam.execution.prompt` | Push | 0.08 | — | 20 | — | Execution attempt: stronger push toward the broken opponent. | katana.execution |
| `cam.tilt.rise` | Tilt | 4 | — | 24 | — | Rising special: camera tilts up to keep the apex in frame. | katana.dps |
| `cam.tilt.launch` | Tilt | 3 | — | 20 | — | Launch: brief upward tilt following the victim. | impact.launch |

## Impact composites (event-driven)

Fired by the simulation's combat events through `EventCueMap`; move data may not fire them. Voice layers named `vo.hurt.*`
speak as the victim.

| Cue | Combat event | Layers | Intent |
|---|---|---|---|
| `impact.hit.light` | Hit | `vfx.hit.light`, `vfx.blood.light`, `sfx.impact.light`, `vo.hurt.light`, `cam.shake.light`, `haptic.light` | Light hit: small spark, light blood, dry impact and a short shake; victim grunts half the time. |
| `impact.hit.heavy` | Hit (heavy) | `vfx.hit.heavy`, `vfx.blood.heavy`, `sfx.impact.heavy`, `vo.hurt.heavy`, `cam.shake.medium`, `haptic.medium` | Heavy hit (knockdowns, launches, bounces, Heavy/Charged/Ultimate moves): bigger spark, blood arc, thump, medium shake. |
| `impact.hit.counter` | Hit (counter) | `vfx.hit.counter`, `vfx.blood.heavy`, `sfx.impact.counter`, `vo.hurt.heavy`, `cam.shake.medium`, `cam.zoom.counter`, `haptic.medium` | Counter hit: heavy hit plus gold ring, pitched ring sound and a small FOV punch so counters are unmistakable. |
| `impact.hit.paired` | PairedHit | `vfx.blood.heavy`, `sfx.impact.heavy`, `vo.hurt.heavy`, `haptic.medium` | Scripted hit inside a throw, execution or ultimate: blood, heavy thump and pain cry (the move adds its own slash). |
| `impact.block` | Block | `vfx.block.light`, `sfx.block.light`, `haptic.light` | Guarded hit: metal sparks and a dry clash; no camera shake so blocking stays calm. |
| `impact.block.heavy` | Block (heavy) | `vfx.block.heavy`, `sfx.block.heavy`, `cam.shake.light`, `haptic.medium` | Guarded heavy hit: bigger sparks, grinding clash, light shake to sell the push-back. |
| `impact.parry` | Parry | `vfx.parry`, `sfx.parry`, `cam.zoom.parry`, `haptic.medium` | Perfect parry: white-gold star, bell clang and FOV punch; the most rewarding feedback in the game. |
| `impact.perfectdodge` | PerfectDodge | `vfx.perfectdodge`, `sfx.perfectdodge`, `cam.zoom.perfectdodge`, `haptic.light` | Perfect dodge into Shadow Time: colour inversion, reversed swell and a slow FOV punch. |
| `impact.counterstance` | CounterStance | `vfx.counterstance.catch`, `sfx.counterstance.catch`, `cam.zoom.parry`, `haptic.medium` | Counter stance caught a strike: ripple burst and blade kiss before the reprisal. |
| `impact.armor` | ArmorHit | `vfx.armor.absorb`, `sfx.armor.absorb`, `haptic.light` | Hit absorbed by armor: amber body flash and a dull thud, no reaction from the victim. |
| `impact.guardbreak` | GuardBreak | `vfx.guardbreak`, `sfx.guardbreak`, `vo.hurt.guardbreak`, `cam.shake.heavy`, `haptic.heavy` | Posture broken: shattering shards, glassy clang, stunned gasp, heavy shake and strong haptic. |
| `impact.launch` | Launch | `vfx.movement.dust.launch`, `sfx.body.launch`, `cam.tilt.launch` | Victim launched into a juggle: upward dust streaks, body whoosh, camera tilts to follow. |
| `impact.wallbounce` | WallBounce | `vfx.wallbounce`, `sfx.body.wallbounce`, `cam.shake.heavy`, `haptic.medium` | Wall bounce: wall crack decal, debris, body crunch (surface switch) and heavy shake. |
| `impact.groundbounce` | GroundBounce | `vfx.groundbounce`, `sfx.body.groundbounce`, `cam.shake.medium`, `haptic.medium` | Ground bounce: floor crack, dust ring, body slam and medium shake. |
| `impact.knockdown.soft` | Knockdown | `vfx.movement.dust.fall`, `foley.body.fall` | Soft knockdown: dust puff where the body lands plus body-fall foley. |
| `impact.knockdown.hard` | Knockdown (hard) | `vfx.movement.dust.slam`, `foley.body.slam`, `cam.shake.light` | Hard knockdown: dust ring, body-slam foley and a light shake. |
| `impact.jump` | Jump | `vfx.movement.dust.jump`, `foley.step.jump` | Jump take-off: dust ring at the feet and push-off foley (surface switch). |
| `impact.land` | Land | `vfx.movement.dust.land`, `foley.step.land` | Landing from any jump: dust ring and landing foley (surface switch). |
| `impact.grab` | GrabConnect | `foley.grab`, `sfx.throw.connect` | Grab connected: hands seize the collar, armour clack; the throw move adds its own cues. |
| `impact.throwtech` | ThrowTech | `vfx.throwtech`, `sfx.throwtech`, `haptic.light` | Throw tech: spark burst between the hands and a slap-apart clash. |
| `impact.clash` | ProjectileClash | `vfx.clash`, `sfx.clash`, `cam.shake.light` | Projectile clash: two energies spiral and burst with a light shake. |
| `impact.projectile.end` | ProjectileEnd | `vfx.projectile.dissipate`, `sfx.projectile.dissipate` | Projectile expired or finished hitting: wisps unravel with a soft puff. |
| `impact.rage.end` | RageEnd | `vfx.mode.rage.fade`, `sfx.mode.rage.end` | Ember Rage ended: embers drift off the body and hiss out. |
| `impact.shadow.end` | ShadowEnd | `vfx.mode.shadow.fade`, `sfx.mode.shadow.end` | Umbral Shadow ended: the echo silhouette dissolves back into the floor. |
| `impact.echo` | ShadowEcho | `vfx.echo.strike`, `sfx.echo.strike` | Umbral Shadow echo strike: inverted ink slash replaying the arc through dark reverb. |
| `impact.knockout` | KnockOut | `vfx.knockout`, `sfx.knockout`, `vo.hurt.knockout`, `vo.announcer.ko`, `cam.slowmo.knockout`, `cam.shake.heavy`, `haptic.heavy` | Knock-out: frozen ink burst, desaturation, slow motion, announcer call and heavy shake. |
| `impact.finisher` | KnockOut (finisher) | `vfx.knockout`, `vfx.blood.finisher`, `sfx.finisher`, `vo.hurt.knockout`, `vo.announcer.finisher`, `cam.slowmo.finisher`, `cam.shake.ultra`, `haptic.heavy` | Knock-out by a finisher: knock-out layers plus blood arc, choir chord, deeper slow motion and ultra shake. |
